review_notes:
The file has one instance, Finsupp.wellQuasiOrderedLE, with hypotheses [Zero α] [Preorder α] [WellQuasiOrderedLE α] [Finite σ]. I read Mathlib/Order/Preorder/Finsupp.lean (instLE, preorder, orderIsoFunOnFinite) and Mathlib/Order/WellQuasiOrder.lean (WellQuasiOrderedLE, WellQuasiOrdered.pi, Pi.wellQuasiOrderedLE, OrderIso.wellQuasiOrderedLE_iff).

I looked at weakening Preorder to LE. WellQuasiOrderedLE only needs [LE α], so this is tempting. The only available Dickson lemma, WellQuasiOrdered.pi, requires [∀ i, IsPreorder (α i) (r i)], and Pi.wellQuasiOrderedLE itself requires Preorder. So the weakening would need new mathematics, or an IsPreorder assumption that is equivalent to Preorder anyway.

Finite σ cannot be dropped. For infinite σ the single-point finsupps give an infinite antichain, for example in σ →₀ ℕ. Zero is needed to define Finsupp. The statement is already stated with Finite rather than Fintype, which is the general form, and with a general WQO codomain rather than a linear order. The docstring's mention of a "Fintype" in the module header is only a documentation matter and outside this rubric.

I found no justified generalisation finding.
